**Dihydromyricetin (DHM)** is a plant-derived flavonoid—most notably found in *Ampelopsis grossedentata* (vine tea) and *Hovenia dulcis* (Japanese raisin tree)—that is widely used in supplements for alcohol recovery and studied for `anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and liver-supporting effects`.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1xqDIXVo8E3zOUTHprdHCJqtSxXrTk5mRh5BEep2QkYOBElHdG_VrDjW7A_T3sSTveoTsfeD1PnBk0s3s8qmDgoe0UiAWKguB-y-c-1P9_YuuJhvpgUpq7psY78IccHOebBW9mL7LAfIYlBfFtuZZmTT7KQVSqnB6NKncdk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF1189XYo6OB2rqYv7RAVxFVW_zAOKEUqmYiU8sJTZNrTA5B230T48_r58D35U7BsNNRMzTUISKbVGmMxB9E-hWqasD7lyuuqDokNNfWkXVR_WG86odtzJvtFdxMw2cSJeFjmw19ijyswExidmfpCfafcAh5g6dc1ho45kNrGUxll8Mp6lpcwgDrnmYU4GAoBvqS4)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF150PNYhjQOKKzIeJx8jgYBT-4pLNirMi79Utp4lC1z7j2SkxpPin-PRwjKBx3EU15p0gdVZ7TCDxgtgLASpr5P-aOd5_7OsS5E1oPAHlfZWt9t4Z8eoxvwi5ks8vBbqkebq-EbB9Pc0NGjMgObZopwQN2rN6rdY40qdPFxJViPUBfA)

### Potential Benefits

- **Alcohol metabolism and hangover support:** Preclinical and supplement studies suggest DHM may speed up ethanol breakdown by supporting liver enzymes (like ADH and ALDH) and interacting with GABA receptors, though it does not prevent intoxication or replace hydration and rest.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXE_dG22r01mXXGknfmqd9UZ6YdjV7UAvmqd9kImc4A40HawlrvwTLKIWy2XxKOdzotGokW7VXS1RWXMtAanJaDXum5zxfaAQkvtG9fjTr_O3j9IuFFS8mKFqq4qq4ZCsEt8OsgbGkecY)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1xqDIXVo8E3zOUTHprdHCJqtSxXrTk5mRh5BEep2QkYOBElHdG_VrDjW7A_T3sSTveoTsfeD1PnBk0s3s8qmDgoe0UiAWKguB-y-c-1P9_YuuJhvpgUpq7psY78IccHOebBW9mL7LAfIYlBfFtuZZmTT7KQVSqnB6NKncdk)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShgEBxCJF150PNYhjQOKKzIeJx8jgYBT-4pLNirMi79Utp4lC1z7j2SkxpPin-PRwjKBx3EU15p0gdVZ7TCDxgtgLASpr5P-aOd5_7OsS5E1oPAHlfZWt9t4Z8eoxvwi5ks8vBbqkebq-EbB9Pc0NGjMgObZopwQN2rN6rdY40qdPFxJViPUBfA)
- **Liver protection:** DHM reduces oxidative stress, inflammation, and fat buildup in liver cells in animal and early human studies, including research on non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF19hIDV4YsIfgWfe5Vi1AxstAIcCCXxQlxl9L2c79PsdHHKRCOpkWKquH8N45hmIkaGWU7K1ukCHxGciAazpyWm_0_O_QGBu9Cv6cU0wbn9rj_m6Dw4-Aox18HZniSHjBRatN4FRNCfV3I97IzAE_yD79nOtMOn9oZ_Gub-6g-s7yKd0kZZy5vqv6)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1xqDIXVo8E3zOUTHprdHCJqtSxXrTk5mRh5BEep2QkYOBElHdG_VrDjW7A_T3sSTveoTsfeD1PnBk0s3s8qmDgoe0UiAWKguB-y-c-1P9_YuuJhvpgUpq7psY78IccHOebBW9mL7LAfIYlBfFtuZZmTT7KQVSqnB6NKncdk)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXE_dG22r01mXXGknfmqd9UZ6YdjV7UAvmqd9kImc4A40HawlrvwTLKIWy2XxKOdzotGokW7VXS1RWXMtAanJaDXum5zxfaAQkvtG9fjTr_O3j9IuFFS8mKFqq4qq4ZCsEt8OsgbGkecY)
- **Antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity:** Laboratory and animal research shows DHM helps neutralize free radicals and lower inflammatory markers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXie3P8zYp8rjLzgnjrc1ALNQv80vZbDHZQoDtj77MpjaRI3EIdLcNJy5ONCh4OEIf-Nn4OEgzLKhX-7f0tCmo7WcHpHyErQ14Bw0_JRuOCYdZU-t0BKtCQ3ypCvMtUQW0ng8mcVrRJSo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF19hIDV4YsIfgWfe5Vi1AxstAIcCCXxQlxl9L2c79PsdHHKRCOpkWKquH8N45hmIkaGWU7K1ukCHxGciAazpyWm_0_O_QGBu9Cv6cU0wbn9rj_m6Dw4-Aox18HZniSHjBRatN4FRNCfV3I97IzAE_yD79nOtMOn9oZ_Gub-6g-s7yKd0kZZy5vqv6)
- **Metabolic and brain health (early research):** Animal studies indicate potential effects on insulin sensitivity, lipid metabolism, and neuroprotection, though human evidence remains limited.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnAEBxCJF1237Z_jbYdGdyM70v_rNRJJDpQ7AKjEl5wH_W4EuOZREm8Lgiz1wGqZfZTRKSqP2-0Vu1mhBQJ5bHoMOPYsS_bsGO5eCvkJvmQp11GbhkCQYrFRnKv6lR2t6Q40UXtV59iqh5HDekAe7UXZJSAqxAW6Kr1AKGINKwxO7FT72_DIEK2HhNNhj5J4rkDRVp-G5EZeIBETn8W8)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXie3P8zYp8rjLzgnjrc1ALNQv80vZbDHZQoDtj77MpjaRI3EIdLcNJy5ONCh4OEIf-Nn4OEgzLKhX-7f0tCmo7WcHpHyErQ14Bw0_JRuOCYdZU-t0BKtCQ3ypCvMtUQW0ng8mcVrRJSo)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF19hIDV4YsIfgWfe5Vi1AxstAIcCCXxQlxl9L2c79PsdHHKRCOpkWKquH8N45hmIkaGWU7K1ukCHxGciAazpyWm_0_O_QGBu9Cv6cU0wbn9rj_m6Dw4-Aox18HZniSHjBRatN4FRNCfV3I97IzAE_yD79nOtMOn9oZ_Gub-6g-s7yKd0kZZy5vqv6)

### Important Caveats

- **Low bioavailability:** DHM has relatively low absorption in the digestive tract, meaning effects seen in cell or animal studies do not always translate directly to humans.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TGSMvBG5tYw&t=39)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXie3P8zYp8rjLzgnjrc1ALNQv80vZbDHZQoDtj77MpjaRI3EIdLcNJy5ONCh4OEIf-Nn4OEgzLKhX-7f0tCmo7WcHpHyErQ14Bw0_JRuOCYdZU-t0BKtCQ3ypCvMtUQW0ng8mcVrRJSo)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF19hIDV4YsIfgWfe5Vi1AxstAIcCCXxQlxl9L2c79PsdHHKRCOpkWKquH8N45hmIkaGWU7K1ukCHxGciAazpyWm_0_O_QGBu9Cv6cU0wbn9rj_m6Dw4-Aox18HZniSHjBRatN4FRNCfV3I97IzAE_yD79nOtMOn9oZ_Gub-6g-s7yKd0kZZy5vqv6)
- **Limited human trials:** Most evidence comes from lab work and animal models rather than large, long-term human clinical trials.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF19hIDV4YsIfgWfe5Vi1AxstAIcCCXxQlxl9L2c79PsdHHKRCOpkWKquH8N45hmIkaGWU7K1ukCHxGciAazpyWm_0_O_QGBu9Cv6cU0wbn9rj_m6Dw4-Aox18HZniSHjBRatN4FRNCfV3I97IzAE_yD79nOtMOn9oZ_Gub-6g-s7yKd0kZZy5vqv6)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXE_dG22r01mXXGknfmqd9UZ6YdjV7UAvmqd9kImc4A40HawlrvwTLKIWy2XxKOdzotGokW7VXS1RWXMtAanJaDXum5zxfaAQkvtG9fjTr_O3j9IuFFS8mKFqq4qq4ZCsEt8OsgbGkecY)
- **Interactions and safety:** Short-term use appears generally well tolerated, but potential drug interactions (such as enzyme inhibition) and individual responses warrant checking with a healthcare provider.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF19hIDV4YsIfgWfe5Vi1AxstAIcCCXxQlxl9L2c79PsdHHKRCOpkWKquH8N45hmIkaGWU7K1ukCHxGciAazpyWm_0_O_QGBu9Cv6cU0wbn9rj_m6Dw4-Aox18HZniSHjBRatN4FRNCfV3I97IzAE_yD79nOtMOn9oZ_Gub-6g-s7yKd0kZZy5vqv6)

You can read more about its clinical trials and pharmacology in the [Alzheimer's Drug Discovery Foundation](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF19hIDV4YsIfgWfe5Vi1AxstAIcCCXxQlxl9L2c79PsdHHKRCOpkWKquH8N45hmIkaGWU7K1ukCHxGciAazpyWm_0_O_QGBu9Cv6cU0wbn9rj_m6Dw4-Aox18HZniSHjBRatN4FRNCfV3I97IzAE_yD79nOtMOn9oZ_Gub-6g-s7yKd0kZZy5vqv6) report or explore broader mechanisms in this [PMC](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXie3P8zYp8rjLzgnjrc1ALNQv80vZbDHZQoDtj77MpjaRI3EIdLcNJy5ONCh4OEIf-Nn4OEgzLKhX-7f0tCmo7WcHpHyErQ14Bw0_JRuOCYdZU-t0BKtCQ3ypCvMtUQW0ng8mcVrRJSo) review.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXie3P8zYp8rjLzgnjrc1ALNQv80vZbDHZQoDtj77MpjaRI3EIdLcNJy5ONCh4OEIf-Nn4OEgzLKhX-7f0tCmo7WcHpHyErQ14Bw0_JRuOCYdZU-t0BKtCQ3ypCvMtUQW0ng8mcVrRJSo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjgEBxCJF19hIDV4YsIfgWfe5Vi1AxstAIcCCXxQlxl9L2c79PsdHHKRCOpkWKquH8N45hmIkaGWU7K1ukCHxGciAazpyWm_0_O_QGBu9Cv6cU0wbn9rj_m6Dw4-Aox18HZniSHjBRatN4FRNCfV3I97IzAE_yD79nOtMOn9oZ_Gub-6g-s7yKd0kZZy5vqv6)Are you exploring DHM for **alcohol recovery**, **liver or metabolic support** , or **general research** ? items.title: Potential Benefits
items.text: Alcohol metabolism and hangover support: Preclinical and supplement studies suggest DHM may speed up ethanol breakdown by supporting liver enzymes (like ADH and ALDH) and interacting with GABA receptors, though it does not prevent intoxication or replace hydration and rest. Liver protection: DHM reduces oxidative stress, inflammation, and fat buildup in liver cells in animal and early human studies, including research on non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD). Antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity: Laboratory and animal research shows DHM helps neutralize free radicals and lower inflammatory markers. Metabolic and brain health (early research): Animal studies indicate potential effects on insulin sensitivity, lipid metabolism, and neuroprotection, though human evidence remains limited.
